opportunities.name: Plan a city weekend trip end-to-end
opportunities.description: For a given city, date range, guest count, activity queries, cuisine and companion, look up city facts and weather, find a hotel, two activities and a dinner reservation, then save a summary note and draft an email to the companion.
opportunities.site: wikipedia + timeanddate + booking + viator + restaurant site (co) + notes + mail
steps: On Wikipedia, search for {city} and open the city article; note the population
On timeanddate, search for {city}, open the city page and its current weather/forecast; note the temperature
On Booking.com, clear the destination, enter {city}, pick the suggestion, choose check-in {start_date} and check-out {end_date}, set travelers to {adults}, click Search
Open a top hotel and click 'Info & prices'; note the name and price
On Viator, search '{activity_1} {city}', open the top result; repeat for '{activity_2} {city}'
On the restaurant site, type '{city} {cuisine}', open the date selector, go to the right month, pick {start_date}, click search, and open a restaurant's details
In Notes, create a note: '{city} {dates}: pop X, T C, hotel H price, activities, dinner R 18:30'
In Mail, fill To={companion_email}, Subject='{city} weekend {dates}', and a Body summarizing the plan; save it as a draft or send it

instances.values: London, Nov 13-15 2026, 2 adults, Thames boat / Tower of London, Indian (Benares), maya@example.com
Dublin, Dec 4-6 2026, 3 adults, Guinness Storehouse / Cliffs of Moher; the restaurant search was started but not finished, and no note or email was written
Edinburgh, Jan 15-17 2027, ~4 adults, whisky tasting / Highlands day trip, Scottish (Evergreen Bar & Kitchen), priya@example.com

opportunities.name: Booking.com hotel search for city and dates
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com for hotels in {city} from {check_in} to {check_out} for {adults} guests and open a chosen property's price info.
steps: Clear the destination field
Type {city} in 'Enter destination' and pick the matching suggestion
Open the date picker and click {check_in}, then {check_out}
Open travelers & rooms, change adults to {adults}, and click Done
Click Search
Open the chosen hotel result and click 'Info & prices'
Record the hotel name and price

instances.values: London, Nov 13-15 2026, voco London Camden Lock
Dublin, Dec 4-6 2026, 2→3 adults, Maldron Hotel Smithfield
Paris (abandoned after opening the date picker)
Edinburgh, Jan 15-17 2027, 3→4 adults, Stylish Leith Residence

opportunities.name: Viator activity search
opportunities.description: Search Viator for '{activity} {city}' and open the top matching tour.
steps: Click the search box and select all of the existing text
Type '{activity} {city}'
Choose the 'Search for …' option (or the direct suggestion)
Open the top relevant result and note its title

opportunities.name: Restaurant table search by city, cuisine and date
opportunities.description: On the restaurant booking site, search '{city} {cuisine}' for {date} and open a restaurant's details.
steps: Click 'Please input a Location, Restaurant or Cuisine' and type '{city} {cuisine}'
Open the Date selector, click 'Next month' until the target month appears, and click {date}
Click the search button ('Let's go' / 'Find a table')
Open the chosen restaurant's details; note the name and 18:30 slot

instances.values: Dublin (only clicked the search box; never finished)
Edinburgh Scottish, Fri 15 Jan → Evergreen Bar & Kitchen

opportunities.name: Draft trip summary email to companion
opportunities.description: Compose an email to {recipient} with the subject '{city} weekend {dates}' and a body summarizing the hotel, activities and dinner.
steps: Click 'To' and type {recipient}
Click 'Subject' and type '{city} weekend {dates}'
Click 'Body' and type 'Hi {name}, plan: hotel {hotel} ({price}), {activities}, dinner at {restaurant} ({cuisine}) on {date}.'
Send it or keep it as a draft (in this session the user clicked Discard)

opportunities.name: Save trip summary note
opportunities.description: Create a note summarizing a city trip: dates, population, temperature, hotel and price, activities, and dinner reservation.
steps: Click 'New note'
Type '{city} {dates}: pop {population}, {temp} C, hotel {hotel} {price}, {activity_1}, {activity_2}, dinner {restaurant} 18:30'
Press Enter to save

opportunities.name: Look up city weather on timeanddate
opportunities.description: Search timeanddate.com for {city}, open the city page and read the current temperature.
steps: Click the 'Search for city…' box and type {city}
Choose the matching city result (click Search first if needed)
Open the current weather/forecast for the city and note the temperature

opportunities.name: Look up city population on Wikipedia
opportunities.description: Search Wikipedia for {city}, open the article and read the population.
steps: Scroll to the top (Ctrl+Home) and click 'Search Wikipedia'
Type {city} and pick the matching suggestion
Read the population from the infobox
